questions.question: The fresh frontend needs a test runner plus a lint/format/type-check gate (there's none in the repo today). Conduct §9 forbids silent tooling defaults — which stack for frontend/?
Constitution 01 recommends Nx for JS/TS monorepos, but this repo uses npm workspaces (inherited from the vendored backend). How should the frontend workspace be added?

The current single required test only checks 6-digit client validation — it can't catch wrong endpoints, stale CSRF, broken routing/logout, or an unreachable shell. How deep should the hermetic proof go?
